title: France Conditions UN Sanctions Relief on 'Major Concessions' by Iran
detail: French Foreign Minister stated Paris will support UN sanctions relief for Iran only after 'major concessions', signaling a hardened European stance in ongoing nuclear negotiations. The position underscores divisions within the P5+1 framework as the mid-June deadline for a nuclear agreement approaches.

media.caption: French Foreign Minister signals Europe's hardened stance on Iran nuclear sanctions relief
